# stripe_product_feature (Resource)

An entitlement feature attached to a product. `terraform destroy` detaches the feature from the product and leaves the `stripe_entitlements_feature` in place. Import with `<product_id>/<product_feature_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_product" "gold" {
  name = "Gold plan"
}

resource "stripe_entitlements_feature" "advanced_search" {
  lookup_key = "advanced_search"
  name       = "Advanced search"
}

resource "stripe_product_feature" "gold_search" {
  product             = stripe_product.gold.id
  entitlement_feature = stripe_entitlements_feature.advanced_search.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entitlement_feature` (String) The ID of the [Feature](https://docs.stripe.com/api/entitlements/feature) object attached to this product. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `product` (String) The ID of the parent object. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the product ID and the product feature ID, separated by a slash.
terraform import stripe_product_feature.gold_search prod_123/prodft_456
```
